name: Clearwater County, ID
findings: Clearwater County has 26 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clearwater County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Clearwater County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
